name: ApcoPay for WooCommerce
author: apcoadriancamilleri

sections.description:
This plugin adds the functionality to pay with ApcoPay to WooCommerce.
* Adds ApcoPay to WooCommerce as a payment option in the checkout page.
* Updates the order in WooCommerce on transaction success or fail
* Supports refunds
* Adds extra charge feature
* Authorisation and Capture
* Checkout via iframe or redirect payment
sections.installation:
1. Move the folder ‘apcopay-for-woocommerce’ inside the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > ApcoPay’.

  4. Input the credentials received from ApcoPay in the settings fields.

    • If using Apcopay Legacy, the fields that need to be configured are:

      • MerchID
      • MerchPass
      • ProfileID
      • SecretWord

    • If using Apcopay Synthesis, the fields that need to be configured are:

      • Client Id
      • Client Secret
      • Signature Secret
sections.faq:
How do I set up a merchant account with ApcoPay?

Send an email to hello@apcopay.com to set up a merchant account with ApcoPay.
